sync.title: Cloud sync
sync.description: Keep your launchers in sync across machines, through OneDrive, Google Drive, WebDAV, a folder or network share, or your own SSH/SFTP server.
sync.destinations.title: Destinations
sync.destinations.description: Switch on as many as you like. Every change uploads to all of them; a download takes whichever holds the newest copy.
sync.oneDrive.signedInHint: Stored in this app's own OneDrive folder. Nothing else in your drive is visible to it.
sync.oneDrive.signInHint: Sign in with a personal Microsoft account. Work and school accounts need the "Folder or network share" destination.
sync.googleDrive.signedInHint: Stored in this app's hidden Drive folder. Nothing else in your Drive is visible to it.
sync.googleDrive.signInHint: Sign in with your Google account. Opens in your browser.
sync.webDav.title: WebDAV (Nextcloud, ownCloud…)
sync.webDav.savedHint: Saved and encrypted on this PC. Enter a new one to replace it.
sync.webDav.passwordHint: Use an app password if your server issues them, not your account password.
sync.folder.title: Folder or network share
sync.folder.description: A UNC path such as \\server\share\LittleLauncher, another sync client's folder (Dropbox, Seafile, a work OneDrive), or a drive you carry with you.
sync.folder.label: Sync folder
sync.sftp.title: SSH / SFTP server
sync.sftp.remotePathDescription: Directory on the server to store settings
sync.sftp.exportImportDescription: Export or import just the SSH connection settings for use on other machines.
sync.auto.title: Auto sync
sync.auto.description: Sync launcher items on startup, on change, and periodically
sync.auto.intervalDescription: How often to download launcher items
sync.actions.title: Actions
sync.message.waitingForSignIn: Waiting for {{provider}} sign-in in your browser…
sync.message.webDavForgotten: WebDAV password forgotten on this PC. The URL and username are kept.
sync.message.signedOut: Signed out of {{provider}} on this PC. Revoke the app's access in your {{provider}} account settings to remove it everywhere.
sync.review.downloadConfirm: Replace this device’s launcher list with the OneDrive copy? A backup of the current data will be saved locally. Device preferences and browser profiles are kept.
sync.review.title: Sync launchers
sync.review.downloadQuestion: OneDrive has the latest changes. Download them to this device?
sync.review.conflictQuestion: Both copies changed since the last sync. Which copy do you want to keep?
sync.review.uploadQuestion: Upload this device’s latest launcher and icon changes to OneDrive?
sync.review.changes: {{added}} added, {{removed}} removed, {{changed}} changed launchers between the copies.
sync.review.backupNote: The replaced copy will be backed up locally. Cancel keeps both copies.
sync.destinations.linuxDescription: OneDrive is available in this Linux preview. Other destinations are shown below and are not available yet.
sync.destinations.notImplemented: This destination is not implemented on Linux yet.
sync.oneDrive.linuxSignInHint: Sign in with a personal Microsoft account. The folder destination for work and school accounts is not available on Linux yet.
sync.auto.tooltip: Sync on startup, when launchers change, and at the selected interval.
sync.importExport.title: Import and export
